sprint: BACKLOG.md -- Add Something Default-Open Right Pane (root Studio only)
task: Closes BACKLOG.md's bug line, verbatim, with an attached screenshot: 'Change right pane to this . [screenshot] Default state of add something should be open.' Investigated js/contextPanel.js's Right Panel Redesign state model (personalizeExpanded/personalizeOpenSection) before touching anything: the CSS/markup for the Add Something accordion (.context-add-trigger's gold-gradient pill, .context-add-grid's 3-column icon-card grid) already matched the screenshot exactly -- the only thing wrong was the default VALUE personalizeOpenSection resolves to, at its two reset points (the module-level declaration, and refresh()'s own genuine-new-selection-cycle reset branch), which was null (closed) instead of 'add' (open). Fixed by flipping both defaults from null to 'add' -- a two-line change, zero markup/CSS/toggle-logic changes, since the existing click handler's toggle expression ((personalizeOpenSection==='add')?null:'add') already correctly opens/closes either way regardless of which value it starts from. Both reset points stay governed by the exact same, unchanged rule this state model has always followed: personalizeOpenSection resets to its default only on a genuine new selection cycle (tracked via _lastSelectionKey), never on a same-selection refresh() triggered by toggling the accordion itself -- so a Story Author who deliberately closes Add Something stays closed for the rest of that selection, reopening only once a real new selection cycle brings the default back around. Verified via a new, decisive 8-assertion Playwright suite (add_something_default_open_verify.js) covering: fresh-boot default-open state with zero clicks (the grid visible, the trigger's chevron showing its open-state glyph, at least 5 cards present); Background Colour/Change Look staying collapsed by default (confirming this is a scoped fix, not a blanket open-everything change); manual collapse/reopen toggling still works correctly; and a genuine select-then-deselect selection cycle correctly bringing the default back to open. Zero unexpected console/page errors beyond this session's own already-disclosed noise floor (Story Egg's still-missing hero.png/magic.png/personality.json art gap, the sandbox's standing Supabase esm.sh network-block), confirmed via a dedicated diagnostic script cross-checking every failing request URL. The broader regression pass found and fixed a real, disclosed, intended consequence of the fix in 3 pre-existing scratchpad test scripts (icon_row_active_verify.js, bold_underline_strike_verify.js, sticker_text_quickedit_verify.js) -- confirmed via a decisive git-stash A/B that each passed cleanly against the unmodified baseline (proving a genuine regression, not pre-existing staleness), then root-caused: all three unconditionally clicked .context-add-trigger assuming it always starts closed, so with the new default-open state that same click now CLOSED an already-open grid instead of opening it, breaking every downstream step. Fixed all three by making the trigger click conditional on .context-add-grid not already being present -- matching this session's own extensively-established precedent of correctly updating a test's own now-stale assumption rather than treating its breakage as a defect in the shipped fix. Re-run clean after the fix: icon_row_active_verify.js (59/59), bold_underline_strike_verify.js (20/20), sticker_text_quickedit_verify.js (32/32), plus bold_toggle_verify.js (22/22), world_owned_delete_absent_verify.js (7/7), and welcome_heading_removed_verify.js (4/4) all passing unchanged. A fourth suite, reorder_colorkit_verify.js, showed 3 pre-existing failures confirmed identical on the unmodified baseline (a pre-existing Doodle medium-switcher DOM-duplication issue, unrelated to and unaffected by this fix). Both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2) pass unchanged, confirming zero World Builder impact -- this fix is confined entirely to root Studio's Context Panel. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder architecture change; confined to js/contextPanel.js.
